source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: In [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), whenever this unit is picked for an [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), it can use Shokk-boosta for that move: it can set its Advance roll to 6 and move through models of any type, and after it ends the move, each of its models takes a [hazard roll](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls).

trigger.event: owner unit selected to make an Advance Move

effects.movementPermission: pass through every type of model

effects.trigger: owner unit ends that Advance Move
